title.narrative: Malaria - Africa - Multicountry Southern Africa E8 (01-Oct-2021-30-Sep-2024)

description.narrative: Multicountry Southern Africa E8, Malaria, SADC Malaria Elimination Eight Secretariat (E8 Secretariat)This program has the following goals: Enable and accelerate Malaria Elimination in the four frontline Countries by 2025. The objectives of this program are: To coordinate and engage E8 member states and stakeholders in achieving the regional elimination targets. To maintain high political commitment to malaria elimination, ensure universal access to malaria interventions, and ensure adequate, sustained technical and financial resources for malaria elimination . To harmonize, synchronize and optimize knowledge sharing and quality control, systems and policy development and implementation policy leading to elimination.
